title.ko: 말을 전하는 동사: suggest · advise · promise

ex.t: He suggested going to the cinema.
The doctor advised me to rest.
He offered to carry my bag.
ex.ko: 그는 내 가방을 들어 주겠다고 했어요.
그녀는 그 돈을 가져가지 않았다고 부인했어요.

ex.t: He reminded me to take my medicine.
They warned us that the road was icy.
They invited me to a party.

explain.ko: 전달 동사는 남이 한 말의 의도를 한 단어로 요약해 줍니다. 형태는 동사마다 달라서 함께 외워 두어야 합니다. ① 동사 + to부정사: promise, refuse, offer, agree (He promised to come). ② 동사 + 목적어 + to부정사: advise, remind, invite, warn (She advised me to rest). ③ 동사 + -ing: suggest, admit, deny (He suggested going). ④ 동사 + (that) 절: say, explain, warn, suggest (He warned us that the road was icy). 부정은 not to ... / not -ing입니다.
explain.en: A reporting verb sums up the speaker's intention in a single word, and each verb has its own pattern. (1) verb + to-infinitive: promise, refuse, offer, agree (He promised to come). (2) verb + object + to-infinitive: advise, remind, invite, warn (She advised me to rest). (3) verb + -ing: suggest, admit, deny (He suggested going). (4) verb + (that) clause: say, explain, warn, suggest (He warned us that the road was icy). Negatives: not to ... / not -ing.

head: 구조 / Structure
동사 / Verbs
예문 / Example
rows: The doctor advised me to rest.
He suggested going to the cinema.
They warned us that the road was icy.

notes.ko: suggest 뒤에는 to부정사가 아니라 -ing나 that절이 옵니다. He suggested to go는 틀린 문장입니다.
notes.en: After suggest use -ing or a that-clause, not to: He suggested to go is wrong.

notes.ko: advise, remind, warn 뒤에는 사람(목적어)이 옵니다.
notes.en: Advise, remind and warn need an object (a person).

notes.ko: 전달할 때 시제는 한 단계 과거로 옮깁니다(will → would, is → was).
notes.en: In reported clauses shift tenses back one step (will → would, is → was).

examples.t: He suggested going to the cinema.
The doctor advised me to rest.

options: She said the exam was on Monday.
She said me the exam was on Monday.
She told the exam on Monday.

lines.t: What did he admit about the accident?
He suggested going hiking at the weekend. He said the weather would be good.
Yes, I promised to get up early. But my brother refused to come.

trans.ko:
A: 민수가 뭐라고 했어?
B: 주말에 등산하러 가자고 제안했어. 날씨가 좋을 거라고 하더라.
A: 너는 간다고 했어?
B: 응, 일찍 일어나겠다고 약속했어. 하지만 동생은 가기를 거절했어.

lines.t: Yesterday at school the teacher told the students that the exam was next Monday. She advised them to revise a little every day. One student asked her to postpone it, but she refused.

trans.ko: 어제 학교에서 선생님은 학생들에게 시험이 다음 주 월요일이라고 말씀하셨어요. 그리고 매일 조금씩 복습하라고 조언하셨어요. 한 학생이 시험을 미뤄 달라고 부탁했지만 선생님은 거절하셨어요.

questions.q: What did the teacher refuse to do?

lines.t: The car stopped suddenly. I admit it was my fault.
Yes, I was driving at eighty kilometres an hour.

trans.ko:
경찰: 사고에 대해 말씀해 주세요.
손님: 차가 갑자기 멈췄어요. 저는 제 잘못이라고 인정합니다.
경찰: 속도를 위반했다고 인정하시나요?
손님: 네, 시속 80킬로미터로 달리고 있었어요.

items.passage:
1) He suggested ___ to the cinema.
2) The doctor advised me ___ rest.
3) She promised ___ come early.

trans.ko: 1) 그는 영화를 보러 가자고 제안했어요. 2) 의사는 나에게 쉬라고 조언했어요. 3) 그녀는 일찍 오겠다고 약속했어요.

items.passage: Yesterday at school the teacher said the exam (1) next Monday. She advised the students (2) a little every day. One student asked her to postpone it, but she (3). We promised to prepare hard.

trans.ko: 어제 학교에서 선생님은 시험이 다음 주 월요일이라고 말씀하셨어요. 그리고 학생들에게 매일 조금씩 복습하라고 조언하셨어요. 한 학생이 시험을 미뤄 달라고 부탁했지만 선생님은 거절하셨어요. 우리는 열심히 준비하겠다고 약속했어요.

items.passage:
NEWS
At a press conference yesterday the mayor promised not to raise taxes next year. But citizens who disagree said they couldn't trust the mayor's word. The council agreed to discuss the issue next week.

trans.ko:
뉴스
시장은 어제 기자 회견에서 내년에 세금을 올리지 않겠다고 약속했다. 그러나 반대 의견을 가진 시민들은 시장의 말을 믿을 수 없다고 말했다. 시의회는 다음 주에 이 문제를 논의하기로 했다.

questions.q: When will the council discuss the issue?

items.passage: After the accident Tom first denied that anything had happened. But later he admitted it was his fault. He offered to pay for the repairs.

trans.ko: 톰은 사고를 낸 뒤 처음에는 아무 일도 없었다고 부인했어요. 하지만 나중에 자신이 잘못했다고 인정했어요. 그는 수리비를 내겠다고 제안했어요.

questions.q: Tom admitted it was his fault.
Tom refused to pay for the repairs.

expressions.t: He suggested going to the cinema.
The doctor advised me to rest.
They warned us that the road was icy.

prompt.ko: 친구나 가족이 최근에 한 말을 전달 동사(suggest, advise, promise, refuse 등)를 사용해 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences reporting what a friend or relative recently said, using reporting verbs such as suggest, advise, promise and refuse.

task.model: My friend suggested going hiking at the weekend. Mum advised me to take a coat. I promised to get up early. But my brother refused to come.

model_trans.ko: 내 친구는 주말에 등산하러 가자고 제안했어요. 엄마는 내게 외투를 챙기라고 조언했어요. 나는 일찍 일어나겠다고 약속했어요. 하지만 동생은 가기를 거절했어요.
model_trans.en: My friend suggested going hiking at the weekend. Mum advised me to take a coat. I promised to get up early. But my brother refused to come.
